name: moai-fetch-web
description: Verbatim web-excerpt fetcher — the moai fetch web command and fetch_web MCP tool. Fetches a page, scores its blocks against a question in two Jev stages, and returns the exact passages that answer the question, unmodified. Use when a task needs the exact passage (a quote, a version string, a config line) rather than a summary. Gated behind workflow.jev.enabled (shipped default false).
